findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_workbooks" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Lists the leadership workbooks by executive coach Jessica Hill Holm that are currently for sale, each with the specific problem it solves and a link to buy." → after: "Read Jessica Hill Holm's active books: Leadership Reset Workbook (USD 49) and free Lead Lagom, with audience, intended benefits, recommendation boundaries and direct Stan checkout URLs; this tool does not purchase."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
